Continue this task in background (up to two minutes)

Notifications show generic status only. Open the task to view content or approve operations. Background mode requires notifications and supports file reads and remote tools; Save As and device UI actions stay in the foreground. Background execution lasts at most two minutes, pauses for approval and stops on lock. Results stay in memory and are cleared two minutes after completion.
